title: Design a notification system
summary: Design a service that sends email, SMS and push notifications reliably, then answer follow-ups on fan-out, duplicates, outages and quiet hours.

questions.prompt: 1 million notifications must go out for an announcement. How do you deliver them?
options: Put a message per recipient (or per batch) on a queue; separate worker pools per channel send them at the providers' rate limits
Send them all synchronously inside the API request that triggered the announcement
One server loops over all users and sends sequentially
Email everyone in one message with a million recipients

questions.prompt: A worker sends an email, then crashes before acknowledging the message, so it's delivered again. How do you avoid a duplicate email?
options: Give each notification an idempotency key and record it as sent before acknowledging; skip keys already recorded
Make the queue deliver exactly once

questions.prompt: The SMS provider starts failing. What should the system do?
options: Retry with exponential backoff and jitter, fail over to a second provider if available, and move messages that keep failing to a dead-letter queue
Retry immediately in a tight loop until it works
Drop SMS messages until the provider recovers
Switch every user to email silently

questions.prompt: A non-urgent notification is due during a user's quiet hours. What happens?
options: It's scheduled for the end of their quiet hours (a delayed queue or scheduler), while urgent security alerts can bypass it
The user is asked to change their settings

questions.prompt: 1 million notifications must go out within 1 minute. What average send rate does that need?

design.scenario:
Design a notification service used by other teams: they send it events ("order shipped", "new login", "weekly digest") and it delivers notifications by email, SMS or push according to each user's preferences.

Write your design in the sections on the right, then answer the interviewer's follow-up questions.
requirements: Deliver by email, SMS and push via external providers
Respect each user's channel preferences and quiet hours
Never send the same notification twice, even when things are retried
Handle spikes such as 1 million announcement notifications within a minute
Keep working when one provider is down
Templates per notification type and language

sections.title: Requirements and assumptions
